descriptor: Distraction-free writing app by one indie developer

voice.summary: Speaks like a solo developer writing a note to friends: plain, personal, a little self-deprecating. Money is discussed openly and without pressure.
dos: Use I and you, one person to one person
Say where the money goes, to the penny
Make free use a first-class option

taglines: Free, unless you'd like to help
Write more, pay what you can
A jar for keeping me writing
boilerplate: Kettle & Pen is a distraction-free writing app made by one indie developer, free to use for as long as you like and supported by whatever readers choose to pay.

microcopy.error: Payment didn't go through, you haven't been charged
microcopy.empty: The jar is empty so far, be the first

logo.note: Coins in a jar mirror the page's pay-what-you-want mechanic.
